description: Unit test class for the MongoDbUriSupplier in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.persistence.mongo.config package. The tests verify the behavior of the MongoDbUriSupplier, such as immutability, exception handling for null or invalid configs, parsing and preserving URI and query parameters, and configuration of SSL and read preferences.

classes.name: MongoDbUriSupplierTest
classes.description: Test class for MongoDbUriSupplier, containing various unit tests to verify its behavior

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that MongoDbUriSupplier instances are immutable and that the Config objects it uses are also immutable

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullConfig
methods.description: Tests that passing null configuration throws a DittoConfigError with a NullPointerException cause

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithoutUriPath
methods.description: Tests that a configuration missing the URI path throws a DittoConfigError

methods.name: preserveMongoDbSourceUriWithoutConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies that the supplier correctly returns the source URI when no configuration options are specified

methods.name: parseQueryParameters
methods.description: Checks that the query component parser correctly extracts parameters from the URI query string

methods.name: preserveQueryParameterOrder
methods.description: Ensures the order of query parameters is preserved when manipulating the parameter map

methods.name: turnOffSsl
methods.description: Tests that SSL can be disabled via configuration, and the URI reflects this change

methods.name: turnOnSsl
methods.description: Tests that SSL can be enabled via configuration, and the URI remains unchanged

methods.name: secondaryPreferred
methods.description: Checks that the read preference can be set to secondaryPreferred via configuration

methods.name: acknowledgedWriteConcern
methods.description: Verifies that the write concern can be set to acknowledged (w=1) via configuration

methods.name: nullValuesAreNotSet
methods.description: Ensures that null configuration values do not alter the URI

methods.name: extraParametersAreAppended
methods.description: Tests that additional key-value parameters are appended to the URI correctly

methods.name: uriWithoutPathOrQueryIsOkay
methods.description: Verifies handling of URIs without path or query components

methods.name: uriWithoutQueryIsConfigurable
methods.description: Ensures URI with no query string can still be extended with options via configuration
